finding.comment: Both reusable workflow references must remain pinned to immutable SHAs; a mutable branch on either job would let upstream pushes run code with CODECOV_TOKEN access.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -6,10 +6,10 @@
 jobs:
   lint:
     uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/lint.yml@d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1
   test:
-    uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/test.yml@e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1
+    uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/test.yml@f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2
     secrets:
       CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

rationale: one of two jobs re-pinned; both stay immutable
